scope: Two official Google API documents, no channel/feed/video/prediction read. Regional France terms remain unavailable from the prior mediated route.

facts: API-services scope covers offered services, related developer documentation and API data; use is governed by the agreement.
Section3.1 requires use by means described in the agreement and service-specific documentation.
Registration information may be required; the document does not prove a universal API-key requirement for every interface.
The agreement incorporates developer policies, guidelines and YouTube terms; no implied further rights are granted.
Credentials are required for some services; service documentation specifies requirements. User authorization depends on the action and is distinct from credentials.
Undocumented API access and reverse engineering are restricted; access must follow authorized documentation.
Cross-owner API-data aggregation is restricted, with a stated exception involving recognized content ownership and viewing by that owner.
The observed window does not include the full later data-storage section; no retention duration or derived-metric permission is concluded.
